# Most Recommended Books
> Human‑curated book database of 750+ people recs, 1 300+ lists, 17 000+ series, and 350+ summaries.

## Core hubs
- [Home](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/) : entry point
- [People](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/people) : 750+ influencers & picks
- [Lists](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/lists) : 1.3k+ consensus “best‑of” lists
- [Series](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/series) : 17 k+ series reading orders
- [Summaries](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/summaries) : 350+ one‑page summaries
- [Blog](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/blog) : editorial guides that support MRB database pages
- [Tools](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/tools) : reader tools as they go live
- [Search](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/search) : user utility for finding MRB pages, not an SEO landing page
- [Contact](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/contact) : corrections & feedback
- [About](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/about) : methodology & team

## Optional
- [llms-full.txt](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/llms-full.txt) : top 50 people & books with links
